newsitem.title: USA: PRI Automation in pact with Kulicke & Soffa.
newsitem.headline: PRI Automation in pact with Kulicke & Soffa.

text.p: PRI Automation Inc said on Tuesday it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Kulicke & Soffa Industries Inc to offer a factory-wide back-end automated material handling system to the semiconductor industry.
Under the terms of the agreement, PRI Automation said it will modify its existing front-end automation solutions as necessary for use in assembly and packaging.
Kulicke & Soffa will market those solutions to semiconductor manufacturers worldwide.
The company said the alliance will give PRI a wider market for its automation products and expand Kulicke's product offerings.

It said the partnership will allow customers to acquire turnkey automated assembly systems from a single source. Such systems are expected to provide higher capital productivity than similar manually run facilities. In addition, the company said, integrated systems can provide better production control and greater adaptability to market fluctuations.
The pact is subject to executing a definitive agreement and approval by the management of both companies.
PRI's shares were down 2-1/4 to 61-1/4 in early afternoon trading. Kulicke & Soffa's shares were up a 1/4 at 26-3/4.
